description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.

    </bpmn:serviceTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_PickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_PickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPack_Label</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPack_Label</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Label_Handover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandOver" name="Hand over order to logistics provider">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Label_Handover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Handover_Tracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Handover_Tracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Tracking_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until it reaches the customer's address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Tracking_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_Delivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Successful delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_Delivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FeedbackReceived" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_Action</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FeedbackAction" name="Take further action on feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_Action</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackAction" name="Further action on feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReturnReceived" name="Return received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_Action</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnAction" name="Take further action on return">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_Action</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReturnAction" name="Further action on return">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Confirmation" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_Send" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_PickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPack_Label" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Label_Handover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Handover_Tracking" sourceRef="Task_HandOver" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tracking_Monitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Delivered" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Action" sourceRef="Start_FeedbackReceived" targetRef="Task_FeedbackAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_FeedbackAction" targetRef="End_FeedbackAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Action" sourceRef="Start_ReturnReceived" targetRef="Task_ReturnAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_End" sourceRef="Task_ReturnAction" targetRef="End_ReturnAction"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
